formulaBlock.normalization: Packet list used as normalized; normalized one-based positions.

cleansingStrength.rationale: C6: no strong anionic. Earliest cleansing surfactant Decyl Glucoside (2, nonionic glucoside), with mild anionics Disodium Laureth Sulfosuccinate (3) and Sodium Lauryl Sulfoacetate (4) -> low.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Cleansing-led: the only conditioning agent is Hydroxypropyl Oxidized Starch PG-Trimonium Chloride (11), after Parfum and both preservatives (trace); no silicone, lipid, refatter, protein.
conditioningLevel.counterSignals: PEG-55 Propylene Glycol Oleate (5) is a thickener, not care.

weightPotential.rationale: One trace cationic starch; nothing converges.

resetCapacity.rationale: Mild glucoside/sulfosuccinate/sulfoacetate chassis (C6 low) with no deposition to offset.

excluded: PEG-55 Propylene Glycol Oleate (5): PEG thickener
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Only one deposition family, trace, without any reinforcing route (W2 permits low).

focusPrimary.rationale: Formula-only: very mild, minimal-care chassis; no specialist route (mildness is not a focus).

usageRole.rationale: Default; frequent with explicit frequency wording.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: CSA not met: no E4 comfort or humectant route in positions 1-6 (Sodium Lactate 14 late). A mild chassis alone is not sufficient (CSA).
